What's your opinion on cultured meat?

Looking forward to it. It will be a breakthrough in many ways. We'll be able to produce meat with far greater resource efficiency and using near-total automation in places it was never possible to farm before; in cities, in homes, in space. We'll be able to eliminate the chemicals and antibiotics abused in conventional farming that have latent impacts on our health and environment. It will be a fundamentally purer, cleaner, food. There will be far more knowledge about the source of cultured meat products than we typically have about traditional meat products. And there will be some new physical forms of meat products to experiment with in new kinds of foods. Some people will fear it because they're afraid of technology or anything new. It will be interesting to see how some people deal with the conflict between eliminating technology in food and eliminating animal cruelty. Culinary purists will insist it can never be as good as traditionally farmed meat products. That's fine. But I think it will be a generally positive innovation.
